strategy_name: Buy the dip when price is 60–80% off the window high (trading at 20–40% of that high), only after a green bar that does not set the high. Never top-tick. Stop 8% below the next open, target 15% above, time-stop after 8 hourly bars. Stop is filled first if a bar touches both.
split: Train is the earlier portion of each pool's hourly bars. Out of sample is the latest oos_fraction of those bars. A rule is learned only on train trades and kept only when held-out expectancy does not fall and held-out trade count stays above the floor.
